question: ‘Mandarin’ is the official language of which neighbouring country of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **China** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mandarin** is the official language of **China**, making it the correct answer.
 
• China shares a significant border with India, making it a **neighbouring country**.
 
• Mandarin is the most spoken language in the world, with over a billion speakers.
 
• It is part of the Sino-Tibetan language family, which is prevalent across East Asia.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Afghanistan
 The official languages are Pashto and Dari.
 
 

 2) Bhutan
 The official language is Dzongkha.
 
 

 3) Sri Lanka
 The official languages are Sinhala and Tamil.
